target.markdown: ## 摘要

source.markdown: In 2019, the rapid rate at which GPU manufacturers refresh their designs, coupled with their reluctance to disclose microarchitectural details, is still a hurdle for those software designers who want to extract the highest possible performance from GPUs.
source.text: In 2019, the rapid rate at which GPU manufacturers refresh their designs, coupled with their reluctance to disclose microarchitectural details, is still a hurdle for those software designers who want to extract the highest possible performance from GPUs.

blocks.text: In 2019, the rapid rate at which GPU manufacturers refresh their designs, coupled with their reluctance to disclose microarchitectural details, is still a hurdle for those software designers who want to extract the highest possible performance from GPUs.

target.markdown: 2019 年，GPU 制造商对其设计进行快速迭代的频率，以及它们不愿披露微架构细节的保守态度，对于那些希望从 GPU 中榨取最高性能的软件设计者而言，依然是一道障碍。

source.markdown: Last year, these very reasons motivated us to dissect the Volta GPU architecture using microbenchmarks. We presented our findings at NVidia's GPU Technology Conference (GTC2018) [1] and published them in a technical report [2].

target.markdown: 去年，正是出于这些原因，我们着手通过微基准测试对 Volta GPU 架构进行剖析。我们在英伟达 GPU 技术大会（GTC2018）[1] 上展示了我们的发现，并在技术报告 [2] 中予以发表。

source.markdown: The introduction in August 2018 of Turing [3], NVidia's latest architecture, pressed us to update our study. In this report, we examine Turing and compare it quantitatively against previous NVidia GPU generations. Specifically, we study the T4 GPU: a low-power, small form-factor board aiming at inference applications. We describe its improvements against its inference-oriented predecessor: the P4 GPU based on the Pascal architecture. Both T4 and P4 GPUs achieve significantly higher frequency-per-Watt figures than their full-size counterparts.

Specifically, we study the T4 GPU: a low-power, small form-factor board aiming at inference applications. We describe its improvements against its inference-oriented predecessor: the P4 GPU based on the Pascal architecture. Both T4 and P4 GPUs achieve significantly higher frequency-per-Watt figures than their full-size counterparts.

target.markdown: 2018 年 8 月 Turing [3] 的发布——英伟达最新的架构——促使我们对研究进行更新。在本报告中，我们将审视 Turing 架构，并将其与前几代英伟达 GPU 进行量化对比。具体而言，我们研究的对象是 T4 GPU：一款面向推理任务的小型低功耗板卡。我们将描述其相对于其面向推理任务的前代产品——基于 Pascal 架构的 P4 GPU——所作出的改进。T4 和 P4 GPU 均显著高于其全尺寸同类产品的每瓦频率表现。

source.markdown: We study the performance of the T4's Tensor Cores, finding a much higher throughput on low-precision operands than on the P4 GPU. We reveal that Turing introduces new instructions that express matrix math more succinctly. We map Turing's instruction space, finding the same encoding as Volta, and additional instructions. We reveal that the Turing TU104 chip has the same memory hierarchy depth as the Volta GV100; cache levels sizes on the TU104 are frequently twice as large as those found on the Pascal GP104. We benchmark each constituent of the T4 memory hierarchy and find substantial overall performance improvements over its P4 predecessor. We studied how clock throttling affects compute-intensive workloads that hit power or thermal limits.

target.markdown: 我们研究了 T4 张量核心（Tensor Cores）的性能，发现在低精度操作数上的吞吐量远高于 P4 GPU。我们揭示了 Turing 引入了能更简洁地表达矩阵运算的新指令。我们对 Turing 的指令空间进行了梳理，发现其编码方式与 Volta 相同，并增加了新的指令。我们揭示了 Turing TU104 芯片的内存层级深度与 Volta GV100 相同；TU104 的各级缓存容量通常是 Pascal GP104 的两倍。我们对 T4 内存层级的每一组成部分进行了基准测试，发现其相对于 P4 前代产品取得了显著的整体性能提升。我们研究了时钟降频如何影响触及功耗或热极限的计算密集型工作负载。

source.markdown: Many of our findings are novel, published here for the first time. All of them can guide high-performance software developers get closer to the GPU's peak performance, as we illustrate with examples.

target.markdown: ## 低层细节决定成败

source.markdown: In this section, we use a practical example to motivate our claim that a deep understanding of the architecture can help developers achieve substantial speed-ups in certain, specific scenarios, although at the cost of significant development effort.

target.markdown: 在本节中，我们将通过一个实际示例来论证我们的观点：对架构的深入理解能够帮助开发者在某些特定场景中获得显著的速度提升，尽管这往往是以巨大的开发投入为代价的。

source.markdown: It takes disproportionate effort to optimize code on the basis of a deep understanding of its target architecture. This approach frequently resorts to writing inline PTX assembly and, when pushed to its extreme, to patching binary code in the pursuit of specific SASS assembly that the compiler won't emit, following undocumented instruction encoding formats, without any support from NVidia's toolchain.

target.markdown: 基于对目标架构的深入理解来优化代码，往往需要付出不成比例的努力。这种方法经常诉诸于编写内联 PTX 汇编，而在追求编译器无法生成的特定 SASS 汇编时，更是被推至极端——按照未公开的指令编码格式对二进制代码进行打补丁，且得不到英伟达工具链的任何支持。

target.markdown: 这些收益是否值得为之付出努力，是一个核心问题，但归根结底，只有你才能根据自身的具体情况和对性能的要求来作答。对于绝大多数 GPU 软件开发者而言，答案是否定的：

source.markdown: • if one of the mature libraries provided by NVidia (such as cuBlas, cuFFT, cuSparse, cuRand, cuDNN, etc.) covers the computation desired, the performance obtained is close to ideal in most circumstances;

source.markdown: Rare are the cases where the pressure for performance justifies extreme, low-level optimization. A prolific line of research has traditionally focused on understanding GPU instruction encoding  $ [4, 5, 6] $  precisely to improve the performance of compute kernels  $ [7, 8, 9] $ . Our prior work on Volta  $ [2] $  also offered such an example: we patched compiler-emitted code so that it used the register cache better, and achieved a 15% higher floating-point arithmetic throughput.

target.markdown: 需要极端的低层级优化才能达到性能要求的案例实属罕见。传统上，大量研究工作一直聚焦于理解 GPU 指令编码 [4, 5, 6]，其目的正是提升计算内核的性能 [7, 8, 9]。我们先前关于 Volta 的工作 [2] 也提供了这样一个示例：我们对编译器生成的代码进行了打补丁处理，使其能够更好地利用寄存器缓存，从而将浮点运算吞吐量提高了 15%。

# 性能对比图：`improved_Saxpy` vs `cublas_Saxpy`

## 图表类型
折线图（Line Plot），带标记点（markers）

## 坐标轴

### X 轴
- **标签**：`Operand array size (KiB)`
- **范围**：0 到 500 KiB
- **刻度间隔**：每 100 KiB 一个主刻度（0, 100, 200, 300, 400, 500）

### Y 轴
- **标签**：`Elapsed time (μs)`
- **单位**：微秒（microseconds）
- **范围**：0 到 8 μs
- **刻度间隔**：每 1 μs 一个主刻度（0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8）

## 图例（Legend）
位于左上角区域，包含两个系列：

| 系列名称             | 颜色   | 标记样式     | 线条样式 |
|----------------------|--------|--------------|----------|
| `improved_Saxpy`     | 蓝色   | 实心方块（■）| 实线     |
| `cublas_Saxpy`       | 灰色   | 实心菱形（◆）| 实线     |

> 注：图中实际显示为：
> - `improved_Saxpy`：蓝色线条 + 蓝色方形标记
> - `cublas_Saxpy`：灰色线条 + 灰色菱形标记

## 数据趋势描述

### `improved_Saxpy`（蓝色）
- 起始于约 (0, 1.2) μs
- 随操作数数组大小增加， elapsed time 缓慢上升
- 在 500 KiB 处达到约 **4.4 μs**
- 整体曲线平滑，略有阶梯状波动（可能源于测量粒度或缓存效应）
- 增长速率较缓，呈近似线性但斜率较小

### `cublas_Saxpy`（灰色）
- 起始于约 (0, 1.1) μs（略低于 blue line at start）
- 随操作数数组大小增加，elapsed time 快速上升
- 在 500 KiB 处达到约 **8.2 μs**
- 曲线整体更陡峭，尤其在 >300 KiB 后加速明显
- 存在轻微锯齿/波动，反映底层实现或硬件行为

## 关键观察

- 在小规模数据（< ~50 KiB）时，两者性能接近，甚至 `cublas_Saxpy` 略优。
- 当 operand array size > ~100 KiB 后，`improved_Saxpy` 显著优于 `cublas_Saxpy`。
- 在最大测试点（500 KiB）：
  - `improved_Saxpy` ≈ 4.4 μs
  - `cublas_Saxpy` ≈ 8.2 μs
  → **改进版本快约 46%**

## 图形特征补充

- 两条曲线均非完全直线，表明存在非线性开销（如内存带宽瓶颈、缓存未命中、调度延迟等）。
- `cublas_Saxpy` 在末端出现“跳跃”式增长（从 ~7.4 μs 到 8.2 μs between 480–500 KiB），可能是由于触及某级缓存边界或系统资源限制。
- 所有数据点均以离散标记呈现，说明是实测采样点而非连续函数拟合。

source.markdown: By systematically disassembling machine code that we hand-crafted and that we sampled from representative CUDA libraries, using cuobjdump and nvdisasm, we discovered the instruction encoding formats adopted across the different GPU architectures. Turing adopts the same format as Volta, which differs from that of Pascal and Maxwell which, in turn, is different from Kepler's, as we detail in this chapter.

blocks.text: By systematically disassembling machine code that we hand-crafted and that we sampled from representative CUDA libraries, using cuobjdump and nvdisasm, we discovered the instruction encoding formats adopted across the different GPU architectures. Turing adopts the same format as Volta, which differs from that of Pascal and Maxwell which, in turn, is different from Kepler's, as we detail in this chapter.

target.markdown: 通过对由我们手工编写以及从代表性 CUDA 库中采样的机器码进行系统化的反汇编（使用 cuobjdump 和 nvdisasm），我们发现了不同 GPU 架构所采用的指令编码格式。Turing 采用了与 Volta 相同的格式，这与 Pascal 和 Maxwell 的格式不同，而后两者又与 Kepler 的格式不同，本章将对此进行详细阐述。

source.markdown: Turing and Volta use 128 bits to encode both an instruction and its associated scheduling control information$^1$. This is a substantial departure from previous NVidia GPU architectures that used one word per instruction (64-bit) to encode pure instruction information, plus a separate 64-bit word every few instructions, to encode control information associated those instructions.

target.markdown: ### 2.1 控制信息

source.markdown: Control words appeared first with the Kepler architecture, which substantially replaced dynamic hardware scheduling with static software scheduling. Control words encode instruction scheduling decisions taken by the compiler [8] that the hardware must enforce. The design choice to use software scheduling in Kepler was a departure from the previous design (Fermi): designers replaced a complex hardware scheduler with a simpler, more efficient one that occupied less silicon area and consumed less power. Overall, software scheduling enabled simpler on-chip control logic, leading to higher compute density per area of silicon and better energy efficiency.

target.markdown: 控制字最早出现在 Kepler 架构中，该架构用静态软件调度在很大程度上取代了动态硬件调度。控制字编码了编译器 [8] 所做出的指令调度决策，硬件必须强制执行这些决策。Kepler 中使用软件调度的设计选择是对先前设计（Fermi）的重大转变：设计者用一个更简单、更高效、占用更少硅面积并消耗更少功耗的调度器替换了原先复杂的硬件调度器。总体而言，软件调度使得片上控制逻辑更加简洁，从而在单位硅面积上实现了更高的计算密度和更好的能效。

source.markdown: Pre-Volta architectures pack one control word with multiple instruction words into a *bundle*. In each bundle, the first word contains control information, and the remaining words (3 on Pascal and Maxwell, 7 on Kepler) encode one instruction each. Each control word affects how the architecture schedules the instructions within the bundle.

target.markdown: Pre-Volta 架构将一个控制字与多条指令字打包到一个**束（bundle）**中。在每个束中，第一个字包含控制信息，其余的字（在 Pascal 和 Maxwell 上为 3 个，在 Kepler 上为 7 个）各自编码一条指令。每个控制字会影响架构如何调度该束内的指令。

source.markdown: **Reuse flags.** Each hardware thread on Turing, Volta, Pascal and Maxwell has a 2-way associative Content-Addressable Memory (CAM) for each of the four conceptual source registers operand positions. This memory is intended to allow data reuse between instructions without accessing any register ports: this relieves pressure on the register file, and helps reducing register bank conflicts (we discuss register bank conflicts at length in Section 3.5.1). Reuse flags control this mechanism as follows: an instruction may flag for saving into the reuse set any combination of up to its first four arguments. Each instruction will attempt to service register reads for its first 4 arguments from the respective reuse slots before resorting to loading values via register file ports. E.g., if the last two reuse-saved registers in the second instruction source operand position were R98 and R99, either of those registers may be used in the second position of instructions without contributing to register bank conflicts. The four bits in the reuse flags map the first to fourth source operands with the least to most significant bits, respectively.

target.markdown: **重用标志（Reuse flags）。** 在 Turing、Volta、Pascal 和 Maxwell 上，每个硬件线程为四个概念上的源寄存器操作数位置各配备一个 2 路组相联的内容寻址存储器（CAM）。该存储器旨在允许指令之间重用数据而无需访问任何寄存器端口：这缓解了寄存器文件上的压力，并有助于减少寄存器存储体冲突（我们将在 3.5.1 节详细讨论寄存器存储体冲突）。重用标志按如下方式控制该机制：一条指令可将其前四个参数中的任意组合标记为保存到重用集合中。每条指令在通过寄存器文件端口加载值之前，都会尝试从相应的重用槽位中为其前 4 个参数提供寄存器读取服务。例如，如果第二个指令源操作数位置上最近两个重用保存的寄存器是 R98 和 R99，则这些寄存器中的任意一个可用于指令的第二个位置，且不会引起寄存器存储体冲突。重用标志中的四位分别以最低位到最高位对应第一个到第四个源操作数。

source.markdown: **Wait barrier mask; Read/Write barrier index.** While most instructions have fixed latency and can be statically scheduled by the assembler, instructions involving memory and shared resources typically have variable latency. Turing, Volta, Pascal and Maxwell use *dependency barriers* to track the completion of variable-latency instructions and resolve data hazards. When a variable-latency instruction writes to a register, the assembler associates it to one of the 6 available barriers by setting the corresponding *write barrier number* field. When a later instruction consumes that register, the assembler marks the instruction as waiting on that barrier by setting the bit corresponding to that barrier in the *wait barrier mask*. The hardware will stall the later instruction until the results of the earlier one are available. An instruction may wait on multiple barriers, which explains why the *wait barrier mask* is a bitmask, not an index.

target.markdown: **等待屏障掩码与读/写屏障索引。** 虽然大多数指令具有固定延迟，可以由汇编器静态调度，但涉及内存和共享资源的指令通常具有可变延迟。Turing、Volta、Pascal 和 Maxwell 使用**依赖屏障**来追踪可变延迟指令的完成情况并解决数据冒险。当一条可变延迟指令写入寄存器时，汇编器通过设置相应的*写屏障编号*字段将其与 6 个可用屏障之一关联起来。当后续指令消费该寄存器时，汇编器通过在*等待屏障掩码*中设置与该屏障对应的位，将该指令标记为正在等待该屏障。硬件将阻塞后续指令，直到先前指令的结果可用。一条指令可以同时等待多个屏障，这解释了为何*等待屏障掩码*是位掩码而非索引。

source.markdown: **Stall cycles.** This 4-bit field indicates how long the scheduler should wait before issuing the next instruction, ranging from 0 to 15 cycles. On Pascal and Maxwell, if the combination of this field and the yield flag contain a special combination of bits, the two dispatchers in a processing block can dispatch two consecutive instructions of a warp at the same time (dual issue). On Turing and Volta there is only one dispatcher in a processing block, and we do not observe dual issue in the generated code.

target.markdown: **停顿周期。** 该 4 位字段指示调度器在发射下一条指令之前应等待多长时间，范围为 0 到 15 个周期。在 Pascal 和 Maxwell 上，如果该字段与 yield 标志的位组合形成特定模式，则一个处理块中的两个发射器可以同时发射一条 warp 的两条相邻指令（双发射）。在 Turing 和 Volta 上，每个处理块中只有一个发射器，且在生成的代码中未观察到双发射现象。

source.markdown: **Yield flag.** As its predecessors, the Turing architecture uses a one-bit yield flag to balance the workload assigned to a processing block. When this bit is set, the scheduler prefers to issue the next instruction from the current warp. When the bit is cleared, the scheduler prefers to switch to another warp, making all register reuse flags for the next instruction ineffective. This costs one extra cycle to switch to another warp.

target.markdown: **Yield 标志。** 与其前代架构一样，Turing 架构使用一位 yield 标志来平衡分配给处理块的工作负载。当该位被置位时，调度器倾向于从当前 warp 发射下一条指令。当该位被清除时，调度器倾向于切换到另一个 warp，从而使下一条指令的所有寄存器重用标志失效。切换到另一个 warp 需要额外消耗一个周期。

source.markdown: Unlike previous architectures (Pascal, Maxwell and Kepler), which organize the opcode in the most significant bits of the instruction, Turing and Volta architectures place the opcode in the least significant bits of the first 64-bit word of the instruction. # GPU 内存层次结构（按私有范围划分）

## 🟦 Private to every GPU
> 最外层虚线框，包含整个 GPU 的所有组件

### 🟩 Private to every SM
> 中间层虚线框，每个流式多处理器（SM）独占

#### 🟨 Private to every processing block
> 最内层虚线框，每个处理块（processing block）独占

##### ✅ 处理块内部组件（Private to every processing block）

- **64 KiB registers**  
  ↔️ 与下方 L1 数据缓存/共享内存双向连接

- **16 KiB L0 instruction cache**  
  ↑ 从 L1.5 常量/指令缓存单向获取数据

##### ✅ SM 级别组件（Private to every SM）

- **96 KiB L1 data cache/shared memory**  
  ↔️ 与上方寄存器双向连接  
  ↔️ 与下方 L2 缓存双向连接

- **2 KiB L1 constant cache**  
  ↑ 从 L1.5 常量/指令缓存单向获取数据

- **~46 KiB L1.5 constant cache/L1 instruction cache**  
  ↑ 向 L0 指令缓存提供数据  
  ↑ 向 L1 常量缓存提供数据  
  ↑ 从 L2 缓存单向获取数据

##### ✅ GPU 级别组件（Private to every GPU）

- **4096 KiB L2 data cache / L2 constant cache / L2 instruction cache**  
  ↔️ 与上方 L1 数据缓存/共享内存双向连接  
  ↑ 向 L1.5 常量/指令缓存提供数据  
  ↑ 向全局显存提供数据（实际为接收来自显存的数据）

- **~16 GiB GDDR6**  
  ↑ 作为最终存储层，向 L2 缓存提供数据

---

## 🔗 数据流向说明（箭头方向）

- `↔️` 表示双向数据通路（可读写）
- `↑` 表示单向数据通路（仅读取或仅写入，图中均为向上供给上层缓存）

---

## 📌 注释

- 所有“KiB”单位指 kibibyte（1024 bytes），非 kilobyte。
- “~” 表示近似值，如 ~46 KiB 和 ~16 GiB。
- “L1.5” 是介于 L1 和 L2 之间的中间缓存层，兼具常量缓存和指令缓存功能。
- “shared memory” 与 “L1 data cache” 共享同一物理空间（96 KiB），可通过配置分配比例。

# GPU 内存层次结构（按私有性分层）

## 🟦 Private to every GPU
> 最外层虚线框：整个 GPU 共享资源

### ~16 GiB HBM2
- 高带宽显存（High Bandwidth Memory 2）
- 所有 SM 和缓存层最终访问的全局主存

↑↓ 双向箭头连接至 L2 缓存层

---

## 🟩 Private to every SM
> 中间层虚线框：每个流式多处理器（SM）独占资源

### 4096 KiB L2 data cache / L2 constant cache / L2 instruction cache
- 统一 L2 缓存，服务于数据、常量、指令
- 被该 SM 内所有处理块共享

↑ 单向箭头指向：
- >64 KiB L1.5 constant cache / 128 KiB L1.5 instruction cache
- 2 KiB L1 constant cache
- 8 KiB L1 instruction cache

↑↓ 双向箭头连接至：
- 24 KiB L1 data/read-only cache

---

##  Private to every processing block
> 最内层虚线框：每个处理块（如 warp 或 thread block）独占资源

### 128 KiB registers
- 寄存器文件，线程私有存储
- 最高速度访问

↑↓ 双向箭头连接至：
- 64 KiB shared memory
- 24 KiB L1 data/read-only cache

---

## 🔹 Shared within processing block (but private per SM)

### 64 KiB shared memory
- 线程块内共享的高速暂存存储器
- 用于线程间通信与协作

↑↓ 双向箭头连接至：
- 128 KiB registers
- 24 KiB L1 data/read-only cache

---

### 24 KiB L1 data/read-only cache
- 一级数据/只读缓存
- 服务于加载指令和纹理/表面读取

↑↓ 双向箭头连接至：
- 64 KiB shared memory
- 128 KiB registers
- 4096 KiB L2 cache

---

### 2 KiB L1 constant cache
- 一级常量缓存
- 专用于 `__constant__` 变量访问

↑ 单向箭头来自：
- >64 KiB L1.5 constant cache
- 4096 KiB L2 constant cache

---

### 8 KiB L1 instruction cache
- 一级指令缓存
- 缓存即将执行的机器码

↑ 单向箭头来自：
- 128 KiB L1.5 instruction cache
- 4096 KiB L2 instruction cache

---

## 🔸 Intermediate Layer: L1.5 Caches (Private per SM, but not per processing block)

### >64 KiB L1.5 constant cache / 128 KiB L1.5 instruction cache
- 介于 L1 与 L2 之间的中间缓存层
- 为多个处理块提供常量/指令预取缓冲

↑ 单向箭头来自：
- 4096 KiB L2 caches

↑ 单向箭头指向：
- 2 KiB L1 constant cache
- 8 KiB L1 instruction cache

---

##  注释说明

- **KiB** = Kibibyte = 1024 bytes  
- **GiB** = Gibibyte = 1024³ bytes  
- “Private to...” 表示该资源在指定粒度下不被其他单元共享  
- 箭头方向表示数据流动或访问路径（↑↓ 表示双向可读写；↑ 表示仅从下层向上层供给）  
- “L1.5” 是 NVIDIA 架构中特有的中间缓存层，非标准术语，但在此图中明确存在

## 观察总结

1. **绝大多数内存地址访问延迟稳定在 32 时钟周期** —— 可能代表 L1 缓存命中或快速路径。
2. **特定地址（如 0, 32, 64...）出现显著更高延迟**：
   - X=0 → 616（最高延迟，可能是冷启动、TLB miss、或特殊映射）
   - X=32, 96, 160, 224 → 188
   - X=64, 128, 192 → 296
3. **模式重复性**：高延迟点以 32 字节为步长交替出现两种延迟值（188 和 296），暗示某种周期性结构（如缓存行对齐、页边界等）。
4. **X=0 是例外**：延迟高达 616，远超其他点，需特别关注其成因。

---

## 建议进一步分析方向

- 检查是否对应缓存行大小（如 64B）、页面大小（如 4KB）或 TLB 条目边界。
- 分析为何 X=0 延迟极高（初始化开销？虚拟地址转换？）
- 验证 188 和 296 是否分别对应 L2/L3 缓存命中或主存访问。
- 考虑绘制“延迟 vs 地址 mod N”以揭示周期性规律。

source.markdown: As the geometry of the L1 data cache is concerned, our findings agree with what reported in the Turing and Volta architecture whitepapers [10, 3]. Specifically, the T4 offers twice as much L1 data capacity, and twice as high a bandwidth as the P4 GPU.

source.markdown: Turing employs an L2 cache that is unified for data, instructions and constant memory, as the previous GPU generations do. # 缓存层级性能分析图（Inverse Throughput vs. Instruction Sequence Size）

## 第一行：多缓存层级对比（L0, L1, L1.5, L2）

### T4 - L0, L1, L2
- **Y轴**: Inverse Throughput (CPI) — 范围 0–10
- **X轴**: Instruction sequence size (KiB) — 范围 0–180
- **趋势标注**:
  - `L0` → CPI ≈ 1.0（起始段）
  - `L1` → CPI ≈ 2.0（约 20–60 KiB）
  - `L2` → CPI ≈ 4.0（约 80–180 KiB），后期轻微波动

### V100 - L0, L1, L2
- **Y轴**: Inverse Throughput (CPI) — 范围 0–10
- **X轴**: Instruction sequence size (KiB) — 范围 0–180
- **趋势标注**:

  - `L1` → CPI ≈ 3.0（约 30–120 KiB）
  - `L2` → CPI ≈ 6.5（约 150–180 KiB）

### P100 - L1, L1.5, L2
- **Y轴**: Inverse Throughput (CPI) — 范围 0–10
- **X轴**: Instruction sequence size (KiB) — 范围 0–180
- **趋势标注**:

- **X轴**: Instruction sequence size (KiB) — 范围 4–44
- **趋势标注**:
  - `L1` → CPI ≈ 1.0（起始段）

### K80 - L1, L1.5, L2
- **Y轴**: Inverse Throughput (CPI) — 范围 0–10
- **X轴**: Instruction sequence size (KiB) — 范围 4–44
- **趋势标注**:
  - `L1` → CPI ≈ 2.0（起始段）

source.markdown: In this section, we map experimentally the size and the organization of the instruction cache hierarchy. target.markdown: 在本节中，我们通过实验确定指令缓存层次结构的大小和组织方式。实际上，这包括：(1) 检测每个缓存层的容量，以及 (2) 确定各缓存层在 GPU 架构模块（调度器、SM、整个芯片）中的分布。

source.markdown: #### 3.3.1 Taxonomy
source.text: 3.3.1 Taxonomy

source.markdown: All GPU architectures we considered, including Turing, feature three levels of instruction caches. To avoid confusion, note that on Turing and Volta the three levels are named differently (L0, L1, L2) than on previous architectures (L1, L1.5, L2). We adopt this established taxonomy for consistency with the NVidia's whitepapers [3, 10] and with prior literature. Pay attention to expressions like "the second level of instruction caches": this expression refers to L1 on Turing and Volta, but to L1.5 on Pascal, Maxwell and Kepler.

source.text: 3.3.2 Size

source.markdown: To detect the size of each cache level, we study how the average inverse throughput (i.e., average clocks per instruction, or CPI) achieved by a long sequence of instructions changes as a function of sequence length. As we increase the length of a sequence, we expect to see a constant CPI value until the sequence exceeds the cache size. Indeed, experimental results show plateaus and ramps (Figure 3.6) which correspond to cache level sizes and transitions from one level to the following. In the figure, the bottom charts focus on the three instruction cache levels, whereas the bottom charts focus on the transition between the last cache level and global device memory.

source.markdown: **Experimental setup.** Our benchmark measures the average CPI seen by a sequence of instructions of given length that exert no pressure on the data cache hierarchy. We iterate measurements for sequence sizes starting from the cache line size up to the larger plausible size of L3. The benchmark executes each sequence twice, but only times the second execution, so that we only measure *capacity misses* and *conflict misses*, but not *cold misses*.

# Cache Privacy and Side-Channel Analysis: Inverse Throughput vs. Aggressor Instruction Sequence Size

## Figure 1: L0 is private to scheduler  
**(Victim probing sequence size: 800 B)**

### Plot Description:
- **X-axis**: Aggressor instruction sequence size (KiB) — range: 0 to 50 KiB
- **Y-axis**: Inverse Throughput (clock cycles) — range: 0 to 4
- **Legend**:
  - Red line: `Aggressor warp`
  - Blue line: `Victim warp`

### Observations:
- Victim warp throughput remains constant at ~1.0 clock cycle across all aggressor sizes.
- Aggressor warp shows a sharp increase starting at ~12 KiB, rising to ~2.0, then oscillating between ~1.9–2.5 up to 40 KiB.
- Indicates that L0 cache privacy allows victim to remain unaffected until aggressor exceeds threshold (~12 KiB), after which contention causes variable slowdown.

---

## Figure 2: L1 is not private to scheduler  
**(Victim probing sequence size: 18 KiB)**

### Plot Description:
- **X-axis**: Aggressor instruction sequence size (KiB) — range: 0 to 80 KiB
- **Y-axis**: Inverse Throughput (clock cycles) — range: 1 to 6
- **Legend**:
  - Red line: `Aggressor warp`
  - Blue line: `Victim warp`

### Observations:
- Both warps start near 2.0 clock cycles.
- As aggressor size increases beyond ~10 KiB, both lines rise together, converging around 3.7–4.0 by 80 KiB.
- Suggests shared L1 resource leads to mutual interference; victim performance degrades in tandem with aggressor growth.

---

## Figure 3: L1 is private to SM  
**(Victim probing sequence size: 16 KiB)**

### Plot Description:
- **X-axis**: Aggressor instruction sequence size (KiB) — range: 0 to 160 KiB
- **Y-axis**: Inverse Throughput (clock cycles) — range: 0 to 6
- **Legend**:
  - Red line: `Aggressor warp (SM 0)`
  - Blue line: `Victim warp (SM 1)`

### Observations:
- Victim warp (SM 1) remains flat at ~2.0 clock cycles throughout.
- Aggressor warp (SM 0) starts near 2.0, rises sharply from ~20 KiB to ~3.8 by 60 KiB, then plateaus with minor fluctuations up to 160 KiB.
- Confirms L1 privacy per SM: victim on different SM is isolated; only aggressor’s own SM experiences degradation.

---

## Figure 4: L2 is not private to SM  
**(Victim probing sequence size: 160 KiB)**

### Plot Description:
- **X-axis**: Instruction sequence size (MiB) — range: 1 to 8 MiB *(note unit change)*
- **Y-axis**: Inverse Throughput (clock cycles) — range: 0 to 16
- **Legend**:
  - Red line: `Aggressor warp (SM 0)`
  - Blue line: `Victim warp (SM 1)`

### Observations:
- Both warps begin near 4.0–4.5 clock cycles at 1 MiB.
- At ~3.5 MiB, both lines jump sharply: victim reaches ~10.0, aggressor follows closely to ~10.0 by 4 MiB.
- Beyond 4 MiB, both plateau near 10.0–10.2, indicating saturation of L2 contention.
- Demonstrates that L2 is shared across SMs — even when victim is on different SM, it suffers significant slowdown once aggressor footprint exceeds L2 capacity threshold (~3.5 MiB).

---

## Summary of Key Findings:

| Cache Level | Private To          | Victim Probing Size | Behavior                                                                 |
|-------------|---------------------|----------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| L0          | Scheduler           | 800 B                | Victim unaffected; aggressor shows periodic contention above ~12 KiB     |
| L1          | Not private         | 18 KiB               | Mutual interference; both warps degrade together                         |
| L1          | Per SM              | 16 KiB               | Victim (other SM) unaffected; aggressor degrades within its own SM       |
| L2          | Not private to SM   | 160 KiB              | Cross-SM interference; both warps degrade sharply beyond ~3.5 MiB        |

> **Note**: “Inverse Throughput” = higher value → slower execution (more clock cycles per operation).  
> All plots show how increasing aggressor instruction footprint impacts victim performance under varying cache privacy assumptions.

# L1.5 Constant Cache Miss Rate (victim) vs. Size of aggressor FFMA sequence (KiB)

## 图表说明

该图表展示了 **L1.5 常量缓存缺失率（受害者）** 随 **攻击者 FFMA 序列大小（单位：KiB）** 变化的趋势。

- **X 轴**：Size of aggressor FFMA sequence (KiB)  
  - 范围：0 到 60 KiB  
  - 刻度标记：0, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60

- **Y 轴**：L1.5 Constant Cache Miss Rate (victim)  
  - 范围：0% 到 100%  
  - 刻度标记：0%, 20%, 40%, 60%, 80%, 100%

- **数据系列**：
  - 使用蓝色实线连接方形数据点（■）
  - 数据点密集分布，反映连续测量值

## 数据趋势分析

### 阶段一：初始平台期（0 – ~7 KiB）
- 缓存缺失率维持在 **0%**
- 表明在此区间内，攻击者序列尚未对 victim 的 L1.5 缓存造成显著干扰

### 阶段二：快速上升期（~7 – ~23 KiB）
- 从约 7 KiB 开始，缺失率迅速攀升
- 在 10 KiB 时约为 15%
- 在 15 KiB 时达到约 40%
- 在 20 KiB 时接近 55%
- 在 23 KiB 左右首次达到 **60%**

### 阶段三：第一平台期（~23 – ~31 KiB）
- 缺失率稳定在 **60%**
- 表明系统进入一个相对稳定的高缺失状态，但未饱和

### 阶段四：二次跃升期（~31 – ~40 KiB）
- 从 31 KiB 开始再次急剧上升
- 35 KiB 时达约 85%
- 38 KiB 时达约 95%
- 40 KiB 时达到 **100%**

### 阶段五：最终平台期（≥40 KiB）
- 缺失率锁定在 **100%**
- 直至 60 KiB 无变化，表明攻击已完全主导缓存行为

## 关键转折点总结

| X 值 (KiB) | Y 值 (%) | 备注                     |
|------------|----------|--------------------------|
| 0 – 7      | 0        | 无影响                   |
| ~7         | >0       | 开始产生影响             |
| ~23        | 60       | 第一个 plateau           |
| ~31        | 60 → ↑   | 第二次加速上升起点       |
| ~40        | 100      | 完全饱和                 |
| ≥40        | 100      | 持续饱和至测试上限       |

## 结论

- 攻击者 FFMA 序列大小与 victim 的 L1.5 缓存缺失率呈非线性正相关。
- 存在两个明显的“阈值”区域：
  1. **~7 KiB**：开始触发缓存竞争
  2. **~40 KiB**：实现完全缓存驱逐（100% miss rate）
- 中间存在一个 **60% 的平台区**，可能对应某种缓存替换策略或硬件限制下的局部平衡态。

# TU104

## 趋势分析

- 所有三条曲线均随“线程束内访问地址数”增加而上升，表明延迟随内存访问分散度增大而增加。
- **L2 const** 延迟最高，且增长最陡峭，尤其在 16→32 区间急剧上升。
- **L1.5 const** 居中，增长较平缓但后期加速。
- **L1 const** 延迟最低，整体增长最缓慢，但在高地址数时仍显著上升。
- 三者之间差距随地址数增加而扩大，说明缓存层级对并发访问模式敏感。

---

## 结论

在 TU104 架构上，线程束内访问的地址数量越多，各层级缓存的访问延迟越高。L1 缓存受此影响最小，L2 最大，体现缓存层级对局部性依赖的程度差异。

target.markdown: #### 3.5.1 寄存器文件组（Bank）

source.markdown: Turing and Volta use a physical register file of 16,384, 32-bit elements in each processing block. Thread-visible logical registers are allocated in increments of 8, or aggregate increments of 256 for all 32 threads in a warp. These register files are organized in 2 banks with dual 32-bit ports each, with logical registers belonging to the bank with the index matching their name, modulo-2. Each port can satisfy only one 32-bit read per clock cycle, and instructions in compiled code requiring three or more operands (such as FFMA, the single-precision floating-point fused multiply-and-add instruction) will suffer a stall in execution due to a register bank conflict if any three source registers' names map to either dual-ported bank.

Thread-visible logical registers are allocated in increments of 8, or aggregate increments of 256 for all 32 threads in a warp. These register files are organized in 2 banks with dual 32-bit ports each, with logical registers belonging to the bank with the index matching their name, modulo-2. Each port can satisfy only one 32-bit read per clock cycle, and instructions in compiled code requiring three or more operands (such as FFMA, the single-precision floating-point fused multiply-and-add instruction) will suffer a stall in execution due to a register bank conflict if any three source registers' names map to either dual-ported bank.

Each port can satisfy only one 32-bit read per clock cycle, and instructions in compiled code requiring three or more operands (such as FFMA, the single-precision floating-point fused multiply-and-add instruction) will suffer a stall in execution due to a register bank conflict if any three source registers' names map to either dual-ported bank.

target.markdown: Turing 和 Volta 在每个处理块中使用包含 16,384 个 32 位元素的物理寄存器文件。线程可见的逻辑寄存器以 8 为单位进行分配，对一个 warp 中全部 32 个线程而言，整体增量为 256。这些寄存器文件被组织为 2 个 bank，每个 bank 具有双 32 位端口，逻辑寄存器依据其名称的模 2 索引归属于相应的 bank。每个端口每个时钟周期只能满足一次 32 位读操作，因此对于编译后的代码中需要三个或更多操作数的指令（例如 FFMA，即单精度浮点融合乘加指令），若任意三个源寄存器的名称被映射到同一个双端口 bank，则会因寄存器 bank 冲突而出现执行停顿。

## 关键观察结论

1. **寄存器选择对性能影响显著**：
   - 使用 `R97` 作为源操作数之一（系列2）导致 elapsed time 出现强烈周期性波动，幅度达 ~1.8 μs。
   - 使用 `R98`（系列1）则表现平稳，无显著波动。

2. **周期性模式暗示硬件依赖**：
   - 系列2中每隔一个寄存器索引出现一次高峰/低谷，可能反映底层架构中寄存器文件访问冲突、流水线停顿或缓存行对齐问题。
   - 特别是当 RX 为奇数时性能较好，偶数时较差 —— 可能与寄存器编号奇偶性相关的内存映射或调度策略有关。

3. **绝对性能对比**：
   - 系列1平均耗时 ≈ 6.6 μs
   - 系列2平均耗时 ≈ (8.3 + 6.6)/2 = 7.45 μs → 明显更慢
   - 因此，在该测试场景下，**使用 R98 比 R97 更优**，无论 RX 取何值。

- 探究为何 R97 引发周期性延迟而 R98 不引发？
- 检查寄存器分配器是否对奇偶编号有不同处理逻辑。

source.markdown: Figure 3.10 illustrates the effect of register bank conflicts on instruction latency on the T4 GPU. We use long sequences of identical FFMA instructions in which we vary one source register index (RX) to cause conflicts. Since the T4 GPU has dual-ported register banks, a conflict will only happen when all three 32-bit source registers in an FFMA instruction belong to the same bank. In every instruction of form FFMA R6, R97, R99, RX in the benchmark, R97 and R99 are in bank 1; if RX also sits in bank 1, a conflict will occur. (R6 is irrelevant as it is a destination register.) In instruction sequence FFMA R6, R98, R99, RX, because R98 and R99 sit in different banks, there is no choice of RX that can cause three reads from the same bank.

source.markdown: As per NVidia's documentation, Turing introduces a new feature intended to improve the maximum achievable arithmetic throughput of the main, floating-point capable datapaths, by adding a separate, integer-only, scalar datapath (named the uniform datapath) that operates in parallel with the main datapath.

target.markdown: 根据 NVIDIA 的文档，Turing 引入了一项新特性，旨在提升主浮点数据通路所能达到的最大算术吞吐量，方法是新增一条与主数据通路并行工作的、仅支持整数的标量数据通路（称为统一数据通路）。

source.markdown: This design is intended to accelerate numerical, array-based, compute-bound workloads that occupy the main datapaths almost completely with floating-point instructions, typically FFMA or HMMA, but also contain a few integer operations, typically updating array indices, loop indices or pointers; or performing array or loop boundary checks.

## Observations

1. **K80 (8B bank)** shows significantly higher latency than all other GPUs starting at 4 threads, indicating severe bank conflict penalties due to its larger bank size or architecture-specific behavior.
   
2. **V100** consistently has the lowest latency among 4B-bank GPUs, suggesting better memory subsystem optimization.

3. **T4, M60, P100** show similar trends and converge closely at higher thread counts, especially beyond 8 threads.

4. **Latency growth is non-linear**, particularly for K80, which exhibits exponential-like increase after 4 threads.

5. At 1–2 threads, latencies are relatively flat and close together, implying minimal contention.

---

## Conclusion

This chart illustrates how average memory access latency increases with the number of concurrent threads accessing different addresses within the same memory bank on various NVIDIA GPU architectures. The K80’s 8B bank configuration suffers disproportionately under multi-threaded access patterns compared to 4B bank designs. Among 4B bank GPUs, V100 demonstrates superior performance, while T4, M60, and P100 exhibit comparable scaling behavior.

## 观察总结

- 所有 GPU 的**实测带宽均低于理论带宽**。
- **V100** 在实测和理论带宽上均为最高，分别约为 750 GiB/s 和 900 GiB/s。
- **M60** 是实测带宽最低的 GPU（约 130 GiB/s）。
- **T4** 的理论带宽显著高于其同组其他低端卡（如 P4），但实测仍远低于理论值。
- **P100 和 V100** 属于高性能计算卡，带宽远超其他型号。
- **K80、M60、P4、T4** 属于中低端或推理型加速卡，带宽相对较低。

# GPU 内存访问延迟测试结果（按阵列大小与步长）

本图展示了六种不同 GPU 型号在不同数组大小（Array size, MiB）下，使用不同内存访问步长（Stride）时的平均延迟（Average Latency, clocks）。每个子图对应一种 GPU 型号。

---

## T4

- **X 轴**: Array size (MiB) — 对数刻度，范围从 32 到 8192
- **Y 轴**: Average Latency (clocks) — 线性刻度，范围从 180 到 520
- **图例**:
  - `32-MiB Stride` — 蓝色线
  - `2-MiB Stride` — 绿色线
- **观察**:
  - 在数组大小 ≤ 8192 MiB 时，两种步长的延迟基本稳定在 ~200–220 clocks。
  - 当数组大小接近或超过 8192 MiB 时，蓝色线（32-MiB Stride）出现急剧上升，达到约 360 clocks；绿色线（2-MiB Stride）保持平稳。

---

## V100

- **X 轴**: Array size (MiB) — 对数刻度，范围从 32 到 8192
- **Y 轴**: Average Latency (clocks) — 线性刻度，范围从 180 到 520
- **图例**:
  - `32-MiB Stride` — 蓝色线
  - `2-MiB Stride` — 绿色线
- **观察**:
  - 绿色线（2-MiB Stride）在整个范围内缓慢上升，从 ~220 到 ~240 clocks。
  - 蓝色线（32-MiB Stride）在大部分区间与绿色线重合，但在 >8192 MiB 处突然跃升至 ~360 clocks。

---

## P4

- **X 轴**: Array size (MiB) — 对数刻度，范围从 32 到 2048
- **Y 轴**: Average Latency (clocks) — 线性刻度，范围从 180 到 520
- **图例**:
  - `32-MiB Stride` — 蓝色线
  - `2-MiB Stride` — 绿色线
- **观察**:
  - 绿色线（2-MiB Stride）在 ~240 clocks 附近轻微波动，在 ~2048 MiB 前有小幅台阶式上升。
  - 蓝色线（32-MiB Stride）在 ~2048 MiB 前与绿色线几乎重合，之后陡增至 ~360 clocks。

---

## P100

- **X 轴**: Array size (MiB) — 对数刻度，范围从 32 到 2048
- **Y 轴**: Average Latency (clocks) — 线性刻度，范围从 180 到 520
- **图例**:
  - `32-MiB Stride` — 蓝色线
  - `2-MiB Stride` — 绿色线
- **观察**:
  - 绿色线（2-MiB Stride）整体平缓，略高于 250 clocks，在 ~2048 MiB 前有微小台阶。
  - 蓝色线（32-MiB Stride）在 ~2048 MiB 前与绿色线重合，之后跃升至 ~360 clocks。

---

## M60

- **X 轴**: Array size (MiB) — 对数刻度，范围从 2 到 2048
- **Y 轴**: Average Latency (clocks) — 线性刻度，范围从 180 到 520
- **图例**:
  - `128-KiB Stride` — 绿色线
  - `2-MiB Stride` — 蓝色线
- **观察**:
  - 绿色线（128-KiB Stride）在低数组大小（<128 MiB）时缓慢上升，之后趋于平稳于 ~240 clocks。
  - 蓝色线（2-MiB Stride）在 <128 MiB 时与绿色线重合，之后在 ~128 MiB 和 ~2048 MiB 处出现两次明显台阶式上升，最终达 ~500 clocks。

---

## K80

- **X 轴**: Array size (MiB) — 对数刻度，范围从 2 到 2048
- **Y 轴**: Average Latency (clocks) — 线性刻度，范围从 180 到 520
- **图例**:
  - `128-KiB Stride` — 绿色线
  - `2-MiB Stride` — 蓝色线
- **观察**:
  - 绿色线（128-KiB Stride）在低数组大小时略有波动，之后稳定在 ~240 clocks。
  - 蓝色线（2-MiB Stride）在 <128 MiB 时与绿色线重合，之后在 ~128 MiB 和 ~2048 MiB 处出现两次台阶式上升，最终达 ~500 clocks，与 M60 行为相似。

---

## 总结说明

- 所有图表均显示：当数组大小超过某个阈值（通常为最后一级缓存容量或物理内存限制），大stride（如 32-MiB 或 2-MiB）会导致延迟显著增加，表明发生了 cache miss 或 TLB miss。
- 小 stride（如 2-MiB 或 128-KiB）通常表现更稳定，因为其访问模式更容易被缓存预取器优化。
- 不同 GPU 型号的“拐点”位置不同，反映其缓存层级结构差异（例如 T4/V100 支持更大数组，而 M60/K80 在较小数组即出现性能下降）。
- 注意：M60 和 K80 使用的是 `128-KiB Stride` 而非 `32-MiB Stride`，这可能与其架构设计或测试配置有关。

# GPU Memory Throughput Analysis Across Four Scenarios

## Scenario 1: single block, contention among groups

**X-axis**: Threads accessing the same address (0 to 30)  
**Y-axis**: Measured Memory Throughput (GiB/s) (0 to 2)

### Legend:
- P100 — blue line with `+` markers
- P4 — gray line with `×` markers
- K80 — dark gray line with solid circles
- M60 — green line with open squares
- V100 — pinkish-brown line with solid squares
- T4 — light gray line with open circles

### Observations:
- All GPUs show relatively flat or slightly decreasing throughput as thread count increases from 0 to 30.
- P4 and T4 start higher (~1.6–1.7 GiB/s) but decline slightly.
- K80 and M60 remain lower (~1.1–1.3 GiB/s).
- Contention within a single block causes performance saturation or degradation at higher thread counts.

---

## Scenario 2: single block, no contention among groups

**X-axis**: Threads accessing the same address (0 to 30)  
**Y-axis**: Measured Memory Throughput (GiB/s) (0 to 2)

### Legend:
Same as Scenario 1.

### Observations:
- Similar trend to Scenario 1, but overall throughput is slightly more stable.
- P4 peaks around 15 threads (~1.7 GiB/s), then plateaus.
- T4 and V100 maintain ~1.4–1.5 GiB/s across range.
- Absence of inter-group contention allows better scaling up to ~15 threads before plateauing.

---

## Scenario 3: contention among multiple blocks

**X-axis**: Blocks accessing same address (log scale: 1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 50, 100, 300, 800)  
**Y-axis**: Measured Memory Throughput (GiB/s) (0 to 12)

### Legend:
Same as above.

### Observations:
- Strong upward trend in throughput as number of blocks increases (up to 800).
- P4 and T4 achieve highest throughput (~11–12 GiB/s at 800 blocks).
- V100 follows closely (~10.5 GiB/s).
- P100 reaches ~10 GiB/s.
- M60 and K80 lag significantly (~6.5–8 GiB/s).
- Contention across multiple blocks still allows high aggregate throughput due to parallelism, though efficiency varies by GPU architecture.

---

## Scenario 4: multiple blocks, no contention among block

**X-axis**: Blocks accessing unique addresses (log scale: 1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 50, 100, 300, 800)  
**Y-axis**: Measured Memory Throughput (GiB/s) (0 to 250)

### Legend:
Same as above.

### Observations:
- Dramatic increase in throughput with increasing block count — especially for T4 and V100.
- At 800 blocks:
  - T4: ~230 GiB/s
  - V100: ~210 GiB/s
  - P100: ~150 GiB/s
  - P4: ~100 GiB/s
  - K80 & M60: ~55–60 GiB/s
- No contention + unique addresses → near-linear scalability for high-end GPUs.
- Lower-end GPUs (K80, M60) show much slower growth, indicating memory bandwidth or cache limitations.

---

## Summary Table: Peak Throughput per Scenario (Approximate)

| GPU   | Scenario 1 (max) | Scenario 2 (max) | Scenario 3 (max) | Scenario 4 (max) |
|-------|------------------|------------------|------------------|------------------|
| P100  | ~1.6             | ~1.6             | ~10              | ~150             |
| P4    | ~1.7             | ~1.7             | ~11.5            | ~100             |
| K80   | ~1.3             | ~1.2             | ~6.5             | ~55              |
| M60   | ~1.2             | ~1.1             | ~8               | ~60              |
| V100  | ~1.5             | ~1.4             | ~10.5            | ~210             |
| T4    | ~1.7             | ~1.5             | ~11.5            | ~230             |

> Note: Values are approximate based on visual inspection of graphs. Actual values may vary slightly.

---

## Key Insights:

1. **Contention Impact**: In single-block scenarios (Scenarios 1 & 2), contention has minimal effect beyond slight throughput reduction; however, in multi-block scenarios (Scenario 3 vs 4), eliminating contention leads to massive throughput gains.

2. **GPU Architecture Differences**: 
   - High-end GPUs (T4, V100) scale dramatically under low-contention, high-parallelism workloads (Scenario 4).
   - Mid-tier (P100, P4) show moderate scaling.
   - Older/lower-end (K80, M60) exhibit poor scalability regardless of scenario.

3. **Thread vs Block Scaling**: 
   - Thread-level parallelism (Scenarios 1–2) saturates quickly (<30 threads).
   - Block-level parallelism (Scenarios 3–4) enables orders-of-magnitude higher throughput when contention is avoided.

4. **Memory Bandwidth Utilization**: Scenario 4 demonstrates that modern GPUs can approach theoretical peak memory bandwidth when access patterns are optimized (unique addresses, no contention).

---

This analysis highlights the critical importance of memory access pattern design and hardware selection for maximizing GPU memory throughput in parallel applications.

source.markdown: The Turing architecture refreshes its Tensor Cores by offering support for a wider range of operand types than Volta. Specifically, Tensor Cores as introduced in Volta were designed to offer high throughput when performing matrix math on half-precision floating point operands; on Turing, Tensor Cores add support for short integer operands: int8, int4 and int1.

# cuBlas 性能与时钟频率随数组大小变化图

## 图表说明

该图为双 Y 轴折线图，展示 **cuBlas 性能（TFLOPS）** 与 **时钟频率（MHz）** 随 **数组大小（KiB）** 的变化关系。

- **X 轴**：Array Size (KiB)，范围从 0 到 8192，刻度为 0, 1024, 2048, 3072, 4096, 5120, 6144, 7168, 8192。
- **左 Y 轴**：TFLOPS，范围 0–100，主刻度间隔 20。
- **右 Y 轴**：MHz，范围 1100–1700，主刻度间隔 100。
- **图例**：
  - 绿色带菱形标记线 → `cuBlas performance`
  - 蓝色带方形标记线 → `Clock frequency`

---

## 数据趋势分析

### 1. Clock Frequency（蓝色线，右轴）

- 起始点（≈512 KiB）：约 **1600 MHz**
- 在 0–3072 KiB 区间：缓慢下降，维持在 **1580–1600 MHz**
- 3072–5120 KiB：明显下降，从 ≈1570 MHz 降至 ≈1500 MHz
- 5120–7168 KiB：持续下降至最低点 ≈**1380 MHz**（在 7168 KiB 处）
- 7168–8192 KiB：小幅回升后再次下降，终点（8192 KiB）约为 **1350 MHz**

> 总体趋势：随着数组增大，时钟频率呈非线性下降，尤其在 >3072 KiB 后降幅显著。

---

### 2. cuBlas Performance（绿色线，左轴）

- 起始点（≈512 KiB）：约 **10 TFLOPS**
- 快速上升阶段（512–3072 KiB）：
  - 1024 KiB: ≈30 TFLOPS
  - 2048 KiB: ≈39 TFLOPS
  - 3072 KiB: ≈41 TFLOPS
- 峰值出现在 **4096 KiB**：≈**47 TFLOPS**
- 急剧下降阶段（4096–5120 KiB）：
  - 4096→5120：从 47 → 18 TFLOPS（断崖式下跌）
- 低谷期（5120–7168 KiB）：
  - 5120 KiB: ≈18 TFLOPS
  - 5760 KiB: ≈17 TFLOPS（局部最低）
  - 6144–7168 KiB：小幅波动于 27–28 TFLOPS
- 最后阶段（7168–8192 KiB）：
  - 7168 KiB: ≈27 TFLOPS
  - 7680 KiB: ≈28 TFLOPS
  - 8192 KiB: ≈34 TFLOPS（明显回升）

> 总体趋势：性能先升后降再回升，存在两个关键转折点 —— 4096 KiB 达到峰值，5120 KiB 出现谷底，之后逐步恢复。

---

## 关键观察点

| 数组大小 (KiB) | cuBlas Performance (TFLOPS) | Clock Frequency (MHz) | 备注                     |
|----------------|------------------------------|------------------------|--------------------------|
| ~512           | ~10                          | ~1600                  | 初始值                   |
| 1024           | ~30                          | ~1600                  | 性能快速提升             |
| 2048           | ~39                          | ~1590                  |                          |
| 3072           | ~41                          | ~1570                  |                          |
| **4096**       | **~47 (峰值)**               | ~1530                  | 性能最高点               |
| 5120           | ~18 (谷底)                   | ~1500                  | 性能骤降                 |
| 6144           | ~27                          | ~1450                  | 开始缓慢恢复             |
| 7168           | ~27                          | ~1380 (最低频)         | 频率最低点               |
| 8192           | ~34                          | ~1350                  | 性能回升，频率继续略降   |

---

## 结论

- **性能瓶颈可能出现在内存带宽或缓存效率层面**：当数组超过 L2/L3 缓存容量（通常对应 4MB–8MB，即 4096–8192 KiB），性能出现剧烈波动。
- **时钟频率下降与性能下降不完全同步**：例如在 5120 KiB 时性能暴跌但频率仍较高；而在 7168 KiB 时频率最低但性能已部分恢复。
- **建议优化方向**：
  - 针对 4096–5120 KiB 区间进行算法或内存访问模式优化；
  - 检查是否因 GPU 核心调度、功耗限制或热节流导致频率下降；
  - 考虑分块处理以避免大数组带来的性能震荡。

## Key Observations

- The GPU reaches its thermal ceiling (~84°C) around 1800 seconds and maintains it thereafter.
- Before 2000 sec, throttling is primarily due to power constraints (“Power-limit throttling”).
- After 2000 sec, combined power and thermal constraints cause erratic clock behavior (“Power-limit + thermal throttling”), indicating the system is actively managing heat and power delivery under sustained load.
- Clock frequency never recovers to initial levels after first drop; instead, it operates in a reduced, unstable band post-throttling onset.

# TDP Normalized Clock Frequency vs. Time (sec)

## 图表标题
**TDP Normalized Clock Frequency (MHz/watt) over Time (sec)**

## 坐标轴说明

- **Y 轴（纵轴）**：  
  `TDP Normalized Clock Frequency (MHz/watt)`  
  范围：0 到 30，刻度间隔为 5。

- **X 轴（横轴）**：  
  `Time (sec)`  
  范围：0 到约 1800 秒，主要刻度标记为 0, 400, 800, 1200, 1600。

## 图例（Legend）

| GPU 型号       | TDP 功率 | 线条颜色     |
|----------------|----------|--------------|
| T4             | 70W      | 蓝色         |
| P4             | 75W      | 橙色         |
| M60            | 300W     | 红色         |
| V100           | 300W     | 黑色         |
| P100           | 250W     | 绿色         |
| K80            | 300W     | 浅蓝色       |

> 注：图例中“V100 (300W)”对应黑色线，“P100 (250W)”对应绿色线，“K80 (300W)”对应浅蓝色线 —— 注意与常规认知可能不同，以图中实际标注为准。

## 数据趋势描述

### 高频段（~16–23 MHz/watt）
- **T4 (70W, 蓝色)**：
  - 初始值约 23 MHz/watt，在 t=0~100s 内快速下降至 ~19。
  - 之后缓慢波动下降，最终稳定在 ~16.5 MHz/watt。
  - 整体呈轻微衰减趋势。

- **P4 (75W, 橙色)**：
  - 初始值约 20.5 MHz/watt，短暂下降后回升至 ~19。
  - 后续保持相对平稳，小幅波动，终值约 18 MHz/watt。
  - 比 T4 略高且更稳定。

### 低频段（~3–6 MHz/watt）
以下四条线几乎水平，无明显时间依赖性：

- **P100 (250W, 绿色)**：
  - 恒定在约 **6 MHz/watt**。
  - 是所有曲线中最高的低频线。

- **V100 (300W, 黑色)**：
  - 恒定在约 **4.5 MHz/watt**。

- **M60 (300W, 红色)**：
  - 恒定在约 **4 MHz/watt**。

- **K80 (300W, 浅蓝色)**：
  - 恒定在约 **3 MHz/watt**。
  - 是所有曲线中最低的。

## 关键观察

1. **功耗效率差异显著**：
   - 低功率卡（T4/P4）具有更高的 TDP 归一化时钟频率（即每瓦特性能更高）。
   - 高功率卡（M60/V100/P100/K80）虽然绝对性能强，但单位功耗下的时钟频率较低。

2. **稳定性对比**：
   - T4 和 P4 随时间有轻微降频或波动，反映动态调频行为。
   - 其余四款高端卡在整个测试期间保持恒定频率，表明其运行在固定功耗/频率策略下。

3. **异常点注意**：
   - T4 在起始阶段出现尖峰（~23），随后迅速回落，可能是启动瞬态或测量噪声。
   - P4 起始也有小幅度上升再回落，但幅度小于 T4。

## 结论摘要

- **能效最优**：T4 和 P4（70–75W）在单位功耗下提供最高时钟频率，适合能效敏感场景。
- **性能稳定型**：P100、V100、M60、K80 虽单位功耗效率低，但输出稳定，适合持续高负载任务。
- **设计哲学体现**：低功耗卡采用动态频率调节优化能效；高功耗卡倾向于锁定频率保障一致性。

source.markdown: We find that Turing uses the same instruction encoding as Volta, but it extends Volta's instruction set; it also introduces a new register type (uniform registers) and supports more operand types on Tensor Cores. source.markdown: The T4 GPU also delivers a significantly higher arithmetic throughput than the P4 on reduced-precision operands.

source.markdown: Turing continues a trend of growth in the scheduler-to-cores ratio, which grew from 1:48 in Kepler to 1:16 in Turing. This trend correlates with a growth in instruction throughput. With their newly introduced L0 instruction cache, Turing and Volta mitigate the penalty associated with their longer instructions. The improved L1 data cache offers lower latency and higher bandwidth. Their new replacement policy also reduces cache miss rates when not using shared memory, and the change from 4, single-ported register banks in Pascal to 2, dual-ported banks facilitates the prevention of bank conflicts.

target.markdown: Turing 延续了调度器与核心比例的增长趋势——该比例从 Kepler 的 1:48 增长到 Turing 的 1:16。这一趋势与指令吞吐量的增长相关联。Turing 与 Volta 通过新引入的 L0 指令缓存，缓解了其较长指令所带来的性能惩罚。改进后的 L1 数据缓存提供了更低的延迟和更高的带宽。其新的替换策略也在不使用共享内存时降低了缓存未命中率；而将 Pascal 中 4 个单口寄存器银行改为 2 个双口寄存器银行，则有助于避免存储体冲突。

source.markdown: Compared to the Pascal P4 GPU, the Turing T4 GPU provides higher bandwidth on L1 cache and global memory. The T4 GPU has higher arithmetic throughput for half-precision, int8 and int4 matrix multiplication thanks to its improved Tensor Cores. In single and double precision, the T4 and the P4 GPUs exhibit comparable performance because they contain the same number of cores and are clocked at similar frequencies.

target.markdown: 与 Pascal P4 GPU 相比，Turing T4 GPU 在 L1 缓存和全局内存上提供了更高的带宽。得益于改进的 Tensor Core，T4 GPU 在半精度、int8 和 int4 矩阵乘法上具有更高的算术吞吐量。在单精度和双精度下，T4 和 P4 GPU 表现出相当的性能，因为它们包含相同数量的核心，并且时钟频率相近。

source.markdown: Using our findings on the instruction set encoding, software designers can optimize their code at the binary level and even construct customized SASS assemblers able to target Turing and possibly generate more tightly scheduled code, that delivers higher performance. Thanks to the memory hierarchy information we disclose, developers can also optimize their code by selecting working sets that match the cache memories at every suitable level, thus reducing miss rates and improving overall performance.

target.markdown: 凭借我们在指令集编码方面的研究结果，软件设计者可以在二进制层面优化其代码，甚至可以构建能够面向 Turing 架构定制的 SASS 汇编器，并可能生成调度更为紧凑、具备更高性能的代码。基于我们所披露的内存层次结构信息，开发人员还能够通过选择与各级缓存容量相匹配的工作集来优化其代码，从而降低未命中率并提升整体性能。
